## Objective
- Improve the existing COURTSIDE 3v3 game, focusing on a better mobile-only HUD with buttons about 50% larger.
- The user also requested improved jump-shot, step-back, contest/block animations, UI, and graphics.

## Requirements
- Make the mobile HUD changes mobile-only; preserve desktop HUD behavior.
- Increase mobile button sizes by approximately 50%.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Build on the existing playable game.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State

### Completed
- Inspected `index.html`, `game.js`, `README.md`, and `Agents.md`.
- Located existing mobile HUD CSS, touch control elements, and animation/gameplay systems.

### Active
- No code changes have been made yet.
- Mobile HUD improvements and requested visual/animation enhancements remain to be implemented.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Update mobile-only CSS in `index.html` to improve HUD layout and enlarge touch controls/action buttons around 50%, while accounting for safe areas and short screens.
2. Review animation and render logic in `game.js` around shooting, step-backs, contests/blocks, player rigs, and the main animation loop; make targeted enhancements.
3. Run the game and check a mobile-sized screenshot; save and inspect only the latest small JPEG as requested.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: HUD markup and responsive/mobile styling.
- `game.js`: Three.js game, touch-control bindings, gameplay, animations, and rendering.

## Important Context
- Existing mobile styles are in `index.html` around lines 155–207 and 244–293; there are duplicate mobile rules, with the later block refining the HUD.
- Touch controls are `.stick`, `.shoot-touch`, and `.mini-btn`; action controls are wired in `game.js` around lines 1692–1700.
- Animation state and render/update logic include `shootAnim`, `stepbackTimer`, `contestTimer`, and `setAnim`; character animation rendering is around line 2881, and the main loop begins around line 3241.
